verdict.rationale: Swell explicitly supports customer-group price rules (wholesale/VIP) with tiered pricing and states wholesale and retail can run from a single catalog/dashboard, covering the price-list and volume-pricing parts of the story. However, there is no evidence of quote generation or net-terms invoicing functionality anywhere in the docs. Missing for 10: quote/proposal workflows, net-terms invoicing, B2B account/company hierarchy management.
